title: Y
author: Sunny Sun
desc: Unlock your strength with this focused 1-week program designed for intermediate lifters. Each 40-minute session combines effective supersets, including the Plank, Romanian Deadlift, and Incline Chest Fly, to sculpt your muscles and enhance your overall physique. Perfect for your garage gym, this program emphasizes core stability and muscle growth, ensuring you maximize your time and effort. Get ready to push your limits and see real results!
